note: Values are restated from maker-hosted catalogue pages/drawings; inch values converted exactly (x25.4). Where several makers print a value, the primary is in values[key] and the others in values[key+"__alt"] (list). Disagreements are in conflicts.

interfaces.standard: "Bottle Grip Taper" (Sumitomo, JIS B 6339 lineage, not named on the page); retention knobs: "JIS-BT 6339" / "MAS 403" (Schunk), "MAS" (Techniks)

taper_length.note: L is drawn from the gauge diameter (oD) to the taper small end in Fig 3.

flange_t.note: t1 drawn across the flange in Fig 3; read as flange width (back face to front face). Consistent with Maritool front-face ordinates (t4+t1) but the reading of the figure is ours.

gauge_to_flange_back.note: t4 drawn from the gauge line (oD) to the flange back face in Fig 3.

flange_D2.note: D2 is a diameter drawn at the V-groove in Fig 3 (smaller than D1); the figure does not name it, so it is not asserted to be the groove root diameter.

key_slot_w.note: b1: drive slot width (end view, Fig 3).

key_slot_t7.note: t7: dimension in the end view from the slot; the figure shows it between the slot bottom and the axis/opposite edge - not interpreted further.

pull_stud_thread_depth_l2.note: l2: threaded-bore length from the small end (Fig 3).

retention_bore_d2.note: d2: counterbore diameter at small end (Fig 3).

retention_bore_d3.note: d3: second bore diameter at small end (Fig 3).

raw_unlabelled.note: Flange/V-groove axial positions and bore lengths per Fig 3; we do not assign their meanings (t2/t3/t5 locate the V-groove relative to the flange; l4 is drawn under the flange).
